evidence: Original init0x00616AA0/0x00616AE0 directly constructs Buffer objects at0x009B9108/0x009B96B0 during CRT startup and registers fini0x00616AC0/0x00616B00 via0x00645398.

The corresponding complete fini callbacks read the initially-zero shared byte0x009B9104, test mask1/2, set that mask before tail-jumping Buffer destructor0x005D7410. No independent duplicate registration or other absolute guard reference is evidenced; do not infer a function-local magic-static cause.

Current source owns those actual objects as CaviarSceneBufferA/B; Caviar::init_class lazily initializes their image surfaces and close_class explicitly closes them. These operations are distinct from startup object construction and registered guarded destruction.

The removed unused g_CAVIAR_BUFFER_1/2 declarations were extra source-only objects, not replacements for actual scene storage. The scene Buffers remain intact; their exact original generated naming/cause and guard emission remain unresolved.
